heading: `AlphaNode` atom
text:
## `AlphaNode` atom [RDSC.4a.6]

One alpha (pattern-filter) node. Admits facts of `schema_name`
that pass all listed tests into the node's memory.

Proto: `proto/alfa.proto#AlphaNode`.

An `AlphaNode` atom with zero tests admits all facts of the named
schema. A REGEX test compiles the pattern string at load time;
the compiler pre-validates regex syntax. Regex flags travel inside the pattern
as an RE2 flag group, and a pattern that does
not compile fails the load ([RDSC.4a.6.1]).
